title: One species row: data/species/rows/<first two letters of sid>/<sid>.json (#276)

latin.description: Latin name; empty for non-living inputs (the table key then falls back to the name)

tl.description: trophic level; 0 = non-living input or decomposers

sid.description: stable id, also the file name

about.description: first sentences of the Wikipedia page

src.description: which job wrote the row; legacy = not known
